_comment: The website. `npm run site:init <address>` fills in baseUrl and points the app at it; everything else here is yours to edit. `npm run release` builds the site from this plus CHANGELOG.md.
_publishDir: The folder npm run release writes the finished site into. 'docs' is a folder GitHub Pages can serve directly, so publishing is a commit and a push rather than dragging files anywhere. Change it only if you know why.
name: GameCut
tagline: A video editor for gaming clips that runs on your machine.
blurb: Multi-track timeline, CapCut-style transitions, a text engine built for titles, beat-synced cutting, and export straight to MP4. No account, no upload, no subscription — your footage never leaves your computer.
_installer: Where the Download button points. 'folder' means the .exe sits next to the page, which is the simplest thing that works. Set it to a full https:// address instead (a GitHub release, say) if the repository gets heavy.
_lastInstaller: Filled in by npm run release so the Download button keeps working on releases that did not rebuild the .exe. Leave it alone.
